assertions.name: meaningful_period_relation_found
assertions.source: Tests the period reframe with an ENTROPY-based meaningfulness criterion (precision > n_terms·log10(2·height)+margin). At A's ~11-digit precision a 12-constant basis cannot yield a non-spurious relation; the 2-term sub-basket probes are the genuinely testable ones. Default: none. A hit is surfaced, not a closure (needs A to ≥30 digits).

description: Direction 3 of the residue-A follow-up: PSLQ integer-relation probe testing whether residue A / prefactor P=A/ℏ_q^15 ≈ 2.0716216 is a period (ℚ-combination of 12 transcendental/volume constants). PRECISION CEILING: A is empirically known to ~12 sig figs (tail_mean limiter), so PSLQ tol=1.0e-11 and a relation is meaningful only if precision exceeds the n_terms·log10(2·height) search-entropy + margin. The full 12-basis relation is SPURIOUS (entropy ≈15 ≫ 11 digits); 0 MEANINGFUL relation(s) (incl. 2-term probes) found. Every relation reported with height + entropy (falsifiable). Diagnostic-only.

pslq_P_A_hbar15.note: height 8 over 12 terms ⇒ search-entropy ≈14.77 digits vs 11.0 precision digits. SPURIOUS — search-space entropy ≥ precision, so a relation of this height exists by chance; NOT structural.

pslq_A.note: No integer relation with height ≤ 1000000 at tol 1.0e-11 (A's ~12-digit ceiling). Target is generic w.r.t. this basis up to that height.

entropy_framing.note: A PSLQ relation among k terms with height h is non-spurious only if precision > k·log10(2h) + margin. The 12-term basis needs ≥~15 digits; A has ~11 — so any full-basis relation is a degrees-of-freedom artifact, not structure.
